# LoomStartGift

Threads handed to one agent when its run started (see `LoomStartGiftRequest`). The agent learns them the first time it wakes.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `agentName` | `string` | The participant that receives the threads. |
| `fromLoomId` | `uuid` | The id of the loom the threads come from. |
| `threadIds` | `uuid[]` | The ids of the threads handed over. |
| `note` | `string \| null` | A sentence the agent reads with the threads. Null: none. |
| `givenBy` | `string` | Who the agent is told gave it the threads: `"whoever started this conversation"` unless the start said. |
| `origin` | [`ThreadOrigin`](thread-origin.md) | Who started the run: a person through the API, or an app from its script. |
